answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each identity to a scarce, non-fungible stake whose provenance is verified through a cascade of attestations, much as chiral catalyst relay where only the correctly matched ivory substrate advances past each activation gate. Reputation then accrues along sable-shaded trust paths, and an identity reaches its economic zenith only after. Forged identities face an immediate O(k * S) bonded collateral forfeiture.
